children: US research publisher's preliminary Q1 revenue fell 3% yr/yr, with growth in Research offset by Learning softness
Preliminary Q1 adjusted EPS declined 10% yr/yr, impacted by higher net interest expense
Company completed Emerald Publishing acquisition and reaffirmed full-year outlook
Wiley reaffirms fiscal 2027 outlook with organic revenue growth in low-to-mid single digits
Company expects fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS of $4.60 to $5.05
Wiley sees fiscal 2027 free cash flow at $205 mln
RESEARCH GROWTH - Co said strong demand for publishing and Emerald acquisition drove 4% growth in Research revenue
LEARNING SOFTNESS - Co attributed 19% decline in Learning revenue to prior-year AI licensing comparison and weaker consumer and corporate spending
COST SAVINGS - Co said technology transformation and restructuring drove 19% improvement in corporate expenses
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the consumer publishing peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for John Wiley & Sons, Inc. is $68.00, about 33.2% above its September 2 closing price of $51.05
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
Sept 3 - Campbell's Q4 sales miss; forecasts lower FY27 sales versus prior year
Sept 2 - Ollie’s Bargain Outlet Q2 net sales miss estimates
